newsitem.title: USA: LCI International sells $350 mln in debt.
newsitem.headline: LCI International sells $350 mln in debt.

text.p: The following debt offering from LCI International was priced on Wednesday according to lead manager Lehman Brothers.
LCI International, based in McLean Virginia, is a facilities-based long-distance telecommunications provider offering voice and data services to commerical, governmental and residential customers.
